hero.heading: OpenPanel vs Simple Analytics
hero.subheading: Love Simple Analytics' privacy focus and clean dashboard? OpenPanel adds product analytics (funnels, cohorts, retention, user identification), session replay and free self-hosting with unlimited data retention.

competitor.name: Simple Analytics
competitor.short_description: Privacy-focused web analytics with AI assistant, clean design, and Netherlands-based hosting.

overview.title: Why consider OpenPanel over Simple Analytics?
paragraphs: Simple Analytics lives up to its name: a clean, privacy-focused web analytics tool based in the Netherlands with a thoughtful AI assistant. For teams that need basic traffic metrics with strong privacy guarantees, it does the job well. But its web-only focus and a free plan that keeps one month of history leave gaps for teams building products rather than content sites.

OpenPanel provides the same privacy-first foundation, cookie-free tracking, no consent banners, EU data processing, while adding the product analytics depth that Simple Analytics lacks. Funnels, retention analysis, cohort breakdowns, and individual user profiles let you understand not just traffic volume, but how users actually engage with your product over time.

Data retention is another difference. Simple Analytics' free plan keeps the latest month of data, while OpenPanel keeps everything on paid Cloud tiers and without limit when self-hosted for free. Self-hosting itself is a key differentiator: Simple Analytics is cloud-only, while OpenPanel runs on your own infrastructure via Docker Compose for complete data ownership.

If you've been happy with Simple Analytics' privacy approach but need deeper insights into user behavior, mobile app support through native SDKs, or unlimited data retention via free self-hosting, OpenPanel is a natural step up.

highlights.title: Key differences at a glance
highlights.intro: Here's how OpenPanel and Simple Analytics compare on key factors.

items.label: Analytics Depth
items.notes: OpenPanel combines web analytics with product analytics including funnels, retention, cohorts, and user profiles. Simple Analytics focuses on simple website traffic metrics with basic goals tracking.

items.label: Self-Hosting
items.notes: OpenPanel offers full self-hosting via Docker Compose with a one-command setup. Simple Analytics is cloud-only with no self-hosting option available.

items.label: Data Retention
items.notes: OpenPanel keeps unlimited data when self-hosted (free) and full retention on every paid cloud tier. Simple Analytics' free plan keeps the latest month of analytics data.

items.label: User Identification
items.notes: OpenPanel lets you identify and track individual users across sessions. Simple Analytics uses anonymization and doesn't track individuals.

items.label: AI Assistant
items.openpanel: Yes, built-in chat plus an MCP server
items.notes: Both let you ask questions in plain language. OpenPanel also exposes 48 MCP tools so Claude, Cursor or your own agent can query your data.

pricing.title: Pricing comparison
pricing.intro: Simple Analytics has a free plan with one month of history. OpenPanel offers free self-hosting with full retention, plus flat cloud pricing. Simple Analytics prices from simpleanalytics.com on November 1, 2026.

openpanel.description: Flat monthly tiers by event volume from $2.50 for 5,000 events, with a 30-day free trial and no free tier. All features included at every tier. Self-host free with unlimited events and full data retention.

competitor.description: Free: unlimited pageviews under fair use, 5 websites, 1 user, the latest month of data, badge required. Self-serve: from €20/month for 100k pageviews (slider up to 2.5M), 1 user included, €20/month per extra user, 2 months free on yearly billing. Enterprise: custom.
competitor.free_tier: Free forever: unlimited pageviews (fair use), 1 month of history, 5 sites

migration.title: Migrating from Simple Analytics to OpenPanel
migration.intro: Both use lightweight scripts and simple event tracking, making migration straightforward.

steps.title: Install OpenPanel SDK
steps.description: Add the OpenPanel SDK to your application. Both use lightweight scripts, so the transition is straightforward.

steps.title: Map Events
steps.description: Simple Analytics custom events translate directly to OpenPanel's op.track() calls.

steps.title: Set Up User Identification (New)
steps.description: Unlike Simple Analytics, OpenPanel can identify users. Add op.identify() calls to unlock retention, cohorts, and user profiles.

steps.title: Configure Product Analytics (New)
steps.description: Set up funnels, retention reports, and cohorts. These features aren't available in Simple Analytics.

steps.title: Remove Simple Analytics Script
steps.description: Once verified, remove the Simple Analytics tracking script. Both are cookie-free so no consent changes needed.

sdk_compatibility.notes: Both use simple event tracking APIs.

historical_data.notes: Most teams start fresh with OpenPanel and run both tools in parallel briefly.

use_cases.title: Where OpenPanel is a better fit than Simple Analytics
use_cases.intro: Choose OpenPanel when you need product analytics, self-hosting, or unlimited data retention via free self-hosting.

items.title: SaaS Products Needing User Analytics
items.description: Simple Analytics shows aggregate website traffic. If you need to understand individual user journeys, retention, and behavior within your product, OpenPanel adds these capabilities while staying privacy-friendly.

items.title: Teams Who Want Self-Hosting
items.description: Simple Analytics is cloud-only with no self-hosting option. If data sovereignty or compliance requirements mean you need to host your own analytics, OpenPanel provides full self-hosting via Docker Compose: one install script brings the whole stack up.

items.title: Projects Needing Longer Data Retention
items.description: Simple Analytics' free plan keeps one month of data. If you need history for trend analysis on a budget, OpenPanel offers unlimited retention via free self-hosting, and full retention on every paid cloud tier.

items.title: Mobile App Analytics
items.description: Simple Analytics is designed for websites and doesn't provide native mobile SDKs. OpenPanel offers iOS, Android and React Native SDKs with full product analytics capabilities.

items.title: Teams Needing Funnel Analysis
items.description: Simple Analytics has basic goals but doesn't offer multi-step funnel analysis. If understanding conversion paths matters, OpenPanel provides detailed funnel visualization.

faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.intro: Common questions about switching from Simple Analytics to OpenPanel.

items.question: Is OpenPanel as privacy-friendly as Simple Analytics?
items.answer: Yes! Both are cookie-free by default and don't require consent banners. The key difference is that OpenPanel allows optional user identification for product analytics, while Simple Analytics is strictly anonymous. You control whether to identify users in OpenPanel.

items.question: Why switch from Simple Analytics to OpenPanel?
items.answer: Teams typically switch when they need product analytics (funnels, retention, cohorts), user identification, session replay, self-hosting, more than a month of history on a budget, or mobile SDKs. Simple Analytics excels at simple web analytics but does not offer these.

items.question: Does Simple Analytics have a free tier?
items.answer: Yes, with limits: unlimited pageviews under fair use, 5 websites, one user, one month of history and a required badge. OpenPanel has no free cloud tier (30-day trial, then from $2.50/month for 5,000 events), but self-hosting is free with unlimited events and full retention.

items.question: Can I self-host Simple Analytics?
items.answer: No. Simple Analytics is a cloud-only service with no self-hosting option. They host all data in the Netherlands on EU servers. OpenPanel offers full self-hosting via Docker Compose with a one-command setup if you need complete data control.

items.question: Which has the smaller tracking script?
items.answer: Simple Analytics offers a light script at 1.9 KB and a full one at 3.7 KB gzipped. OpenPanel's is about 3 KB gzipped. All are far smaller than Google Analytics (45 KB+).

items.question: Can Simple Analytics track mobile apps?
items.answer: Not natively. Simple Analytics is designed for web analytics and doesn't provide mobile SDKs. They have an iOS app to view your dashboard, but not to track mobile app users. OpenPanel offers iOS, Android and React Native SDKs.

items.question: What will I lose switching from Simple Analytics?
items.answer: The Mini Websites view of exactly which pages linked to you, the Google Analytics import and the iOS app for checking your dashboard. Both tools have an AI assistant. You gain product analytics, session replay, self-hosting and user identification.

items.question: Is Simple Analytics or OpenPanel better for blogs/content sites?
items.answer: For simple content sites where you just need traffic stats, Simple Analytics' simplicity and free plan are excellent, and Mini Websites shows exactly which tweets or pages linked to you. For a SaaS, a shop or any product where user behavior matters, OpenPanel's product analytics provide more value.
